## Everus Announces Authorization of New $100 Million Share Repurchase Program


November 16, 2026


BISMARCK, N.D.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Everus Construction Group (NYSE: ECG) announced today that its Board of Directors has authorized a new $100 million share repurchase program, providing the company with additional flexibility to execute its returns-based capital allocation strategy.


“Our new share repurchase authorization reflects our strong financial position, confidence in our business outlook and our commitment to the efficient allocation of capital,” said Jeffrey S. Thiede, president and CEO of Everus. “We continue to believe our strongest opportunities to create long-term value are through organic investments in our business and disciplined strategic acquisitions that diversify our business, expand our geographic reach and deepen our market presence. At the same time, we believe a balanced approach to capital allocation is important, and this authorization provides us with flexibility to repurchase shares when we believe doing so represents an attractive use of capital. This program does not change our investment priorities or our confidence in the significant growth opportunities ahead but emphasizes our ongoing focus on driving long-term value for our stockholders.”


The share repurchase program has an expiration date of Dec. 15, 2029. Shares may be repurchased through open-market purchases, pursuant to Rule 10b5-1 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended; privately negotiated transactions; or other means, subject to market conditions, liquidity needs, restrictions under the company’s debt arrangements and other factors. The program does not obligate the company to repurchase any specific number of shares and may be modified, suspended or discontinued at any time.


The company expects to maintain its financial flexibility to support ongoing organic investments and pursue strategic acquisitions while evaluating opportunities to repurchase shares.

**About Everus Construction Group**


*Everus Construction Group, Inc., a member of the S&P SmallCap 600® index, is Building America's Future® by providing a full spectrum of construction services through its electrical and mechanical, and transmission and distribution specialty contracting services across the United States. These specialty contracting services are provided to commercial, industrial, institutional, renewables, service, transportation, utility and other customers. Its E&M contracting services include construction and maintenance of electrical and communication wiring and infrastructure, fire suppression systems, and mechanical piping and services. Its T&D contracting services include construction and maintenance of overhead and underground electrical, gas and communication infrastructure, as well as the manufacture and distribution of transmission line construction equipment.
